newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian inflation expecations fall - survey.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian inflation expecations fall - survey.

text.p: Australian inflationary expectations fell to an annual 4.5 percent in September from 4.8 percent in August, the Westpac-Melbourne Institute said in its monthly survey.
"A mild downward trend in the median, observable from June, has been confirmed in this September survey," the institute said.

"In September, the median (rate of price rises expected by consumers over the next 12 months) dropped to 4.5 percent - down from the levels of between 4.7 and 5.0 percent of the past five months," it said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
